questions.question: In fabric, which direction runs along the width?
questions.explanation: Warp direction runs along the width.

questions.question: Which fabric direction runs along the height?
What term describes the diagonal fabric direction?
What runs parallel to the 0° direction?
questions.explanation: Selvage runs parallel to the 0° direction.

questions.question: What is the main direction of a honeycomb structure called?
questions.explanation: Ribbon is the main direction of the honeycomb structure.
